items.title: 16.9 Resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ka exponential decay (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.9 with Figs. 16.14-16.16, the box and Example 16.10 (PDF 78-80).

blocks.text: Pichhle hisse mein Fig. 16.13 (a) mein resistor ke zariye discharge hone wala RC circuit dekha. Us ke charge aur waqt ka graph Fig. 16.14 mein hai. Charge Q waqt t ke saath exponentially (pehle tezi se, phir aahista) kam hota hai. Aam zabaan mein exponential ka matlab hai bohat tezi se barhna ya ghatna. Maths (riyazi) mein exponential function woh hai jis mein variable power (exponent) mein ho:
Yahan a constant aur x exponent (variable) hai. RC circuit mein discharge hone wale capacitor ka aam exponential decay formula yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Discharge hote capacitor ke charge aur waqt ka graph: curve oonchai se shuru ho kar pehle tezi se aur phir ahista ahista girta hai aur time axis ke qareeb flat (seedha) ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.14: Discharge hote capacitor ka charge aur waqt (kitab ki Figure 16.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan x koi bhi quantity (miqdar), jaise charge, voltage ya current, hai waqt t par.

items: x₀ = t = 0 par us quantity ki initial (shuru wali) value.
RC = time constant (τ), jo batata hai ke capacitor kitni jaldi discharge hota hai.
e = aik maths constant (Euler's number), natural logarithm (logₑ ya ln) ka base; is ki qeemat taqreeban 2.718 hai.

blocks.text: Power mein minus (−t/RC) batata hai ke quantity waqt ke saath exponentially kam hoti hai.
Eq. 16.43 se kisi bhi waqt t par charge, voltage aur current ki kami yun likhi jati hai:

blocks.alt: Qo se shuru hone wala charge aur waqt ka graph. Pehle time interval (waqfa) t ke baad charge Q hai. Baad mein, utne hi lambe interval t mein, charge Qo' se Q' tak girta hai, jo kahin chhoti kami hai. Dashed lines charge axis par Q, Qo' aur Q' dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.15: Barabar time intervals t mein charge ki kami (kitab ki Figure 16.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.latex: Q = Q_0e^{-t/RC},\; V = V_0e^{-t/RC} \;\text{and}\; I = I_0e^{-t/RC}.
blocks.text_alt: Q = Q₀e^(−t/RC), V = V₀e^(−t/RC) and I = I₀e^(−t/RC).

blocks.text: Teenon ke graph shuru mein bohat steep (dhalwan, yani tez discharge) hote hain aur waqt ke saath flat (chapte) hote jate hain, yani discharge slow (sust) hota jata hai. Fig. 16.15 charge ka graph dikhati hai.

Shuru mein charge Q₀ (t = 0) hai aur waqt t baad Q reh jata hai. Baad mein kisi aur lamhe charge Q₀′ ho, to utne hi waqt t baad woh Q′ reh jata hai. Shuru mein kami (Q₀ − Q) thi, baad mein kami (Q₀′ − Q′) hai, jo pehle se kam hai. Wajah: har barabar interval mein charge apne maujooda hisse ka aik jaisa fraction khota hai, is liye charge kam ho to kami bhi kam hoti hai.

Charge ka ghatna tanki se patle pipe ke zariye pani nikalne jaisa hai. Pani ka level (satah) aur pressure (dabao) charge aur voltage jaise hain, aur pani ke flow (bahao) ka rate current jaisa. Shuru mein level ooncha hai, pressure zyada hai aur pani tez nikalta hai. Level girne se pressure kam hota hai aur flow slow ho jata hai.

blocks.title: For your information
blocks.text: Exponential functions physics ki bohat si cheezon (phenomena) ko sahi sahi bayan karte hain, jaise radioactive decay, jahan kisi cheez ke badalne ka rate us ki maujooda quantity par seedha depend karta hai.
